intent: Turn one of the31 frozen standard layer jobs into all aligned4x4 tile jobs; no arbitrary graph engine or data storage
reset: 100MHz common asynchronous assert/two-edge release; cancel/fault retains busy until common reset
ownership: system grants unique compute/workstore owner for the whole busy interval; tile_done is accepted only in WAIT after tile start handshake and denotes all source/WIF/core responses retired plus output barrier accepted
order: fixed layer_id selects frozen H/W; tile_y outer, tile_x inner, x/y step4; H18 final tile has valid two rows handled by actual client
handshake: tile start payload held until ready; advance only actual tile_done; layer done only after final tile_done; no fake timeout retirement
boundary: sequence coverage is not full-layer numerical output, actual CSP/backbone chain or DDR write visibility; actual client must be connected and retired
verification: all tile identities in exact order
